answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the copper to sunk effort, uses the violet as an corroborating signal, then requires a walnut before any payout.
